desc: Rank the players by score, highest first, using standard competition ranking ("1224"): a player's rank is 1 plus the number of players with a strictly higher score, so equal scores share a rank and the next rank is skipped accordingly. Return (rank, name) pairs ordered by score (highest first); players with equal scores are ordered by name in ascending code-point order.

decls.ts: type Player = { name: string; score: number };
